note_on_verdict: The problem was not closed in either direction. Nothing in this campaign narrows the gap described in gap_to_close.

gap_to_close.erdos_sarkozy: |r_A(n) - log n| / sqrt(log n) -> 0 is impossible
gap_to_close.horvath_Ho07: |r_A(n) - log n| <= (1-eps) sqrt(log n) cannot hold for all large n
gap_to_close.distance: a full sqrt(log n) factor; not narrowed by this campaign
gap_to_close.affirmative_side: no construction known; the source records that a random set works only if an exceptional set of density zero is permitted, which the problem forbids

semantic_binding.rep_eq_sumConv: rep A n = sum over antidiagonal n of 1_A p.1 * 1_A p.2 -- proves the object studied is the upstream sumRep; ordered pairs, diagonal included

exact_finite_structure.pairsLe_eq_biUnion: antidiagonals below N partition the pairs of sum <= N
exact_finite_structure.sum_rep_eq: sum_{n<=N} r_A(n) = #{(a,b) in A^2 : a+b <= N}
exact_finite_structure.rep_le_of_finite: finite A implies r_A bounded by |A|^2

necessary_conditions_on_any_witness.exists_uniform_rep_bound: exists M >= 0 with r_A(n) <= M + (c+1) log n for EVERY n
necessary_conditions_on_any_witness.cnt_sq_le_of_tendsto: UPPER: cnt(A,N/2)^2 <= (N+1)M + (c+1)(N+1) log N, i.e. cnt(A,N) = O(sqrt(N log N))
necessary_conditions_on_any_witness.le_cnt_sq_of_tendsto: LOWER: eventually (N/2)(c/2) log(N/2) <= cnt(A,N)^2, i.e. cnt(A,N) >> sqrt(N log N)

banked_lean.net_structural_statement: any A witnessing Erdos 66 with limit c has counting function pinned to cnt(A,N) asymptotically of order sqrt(N log N), both directions kernel-checked

numeric_verification.method: brute-force enumeration of ordered pairs, independent of the Lean proof
numeric_verification.transfer_caveat: Per the source page and CONTRACT.md, NO finite computation can resolve Erdos 66. This run tests the finite lemmas the Lean rests on; it is not evidence about the problem itself.

parity_law.statement: r_A(n) is odd iff n = a+a for some a in A; equivalently r_A(n) is even for every odd n
parity_law.evidence: verified exactly on all 414 finite cases; NOT formalised in Lean

paper_level_UNPROVED_in_lean.sharp_constant_chain: sqrt(c) <= liminf g <= 2*sqrt(c/pi) <= limsup g <= sqrt(2c), where g(N) = cnt(A,N)/sqrt(N log N)
paper_level_UNPROVED_in_lean.kernel_checked_part: the two OUTER inequalities (they are cnt_sq_le_of_tendsto and le_cnt_sq_of_tendsto)
paper_level_UNPROVED_in_lean.unproved_part: the two INNER inequalities, from Stieltjes integration by parts / Karamata; hand proof only, NOT kernel-checked

numeric_consistency_evidence_only.caveat: one random model set; proves nothing

prior_estate_work_superseded.banked: no Lean, no receipts, no theorem
prior_estate_work_superseded.this_campaign: first to leave kernel-checked artifacts on erdos:66

claim_ceiling: The mathematics banked here is elementary and classical in character. The artifact of value is the machine-checked formalisation and the receipts, NOT a novel theorem. Erdos 66 remains open; openness is the source's marking, not ours.
